data.description: Sky Residences: Elevated Living in Dubai
data.long_description:
Sky Residences is a project by developer Expo City, located in the Expo City Dubai neighborhood, which is a unique eco-friendly community. The complex consists of three 15-storey towers, the design of which combines luxurious design and modern architecture. It offers spacious and stylish 1-3 bedroom apartments with panoramic views of Al Wasl Plaza and Surreal Waterfall.

The complex offers a wide range of amenities to ensure residents a comfortable stay. These include: a swimming pool and spa center where you can refresh yourself and enjoy massages, sauna and other treatments for total relaxation, a fitness center and fitness areas where you can work out, as well as running and cycling tracks to keep fit, beautiful green areas and parks where you can enjoy fresh air, walks and spending time in nature. For families with children, the complex offers a children's playground where kids can play and spend time outdoors. This is a safe and cozy place where children can have fun and develop.

Advantageous location near the main highways of Dubai allows residents of the complex to quickly get to key points of the city. In 20 minutes are located Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, in 30 minutes - Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, and the road to Dubai International Airport will take about 35 minutes.
